tweets.text:
Do you know me? 🤔
A journey of persistence!

The Beginning - Passion for Technology

Since I was 13 years old, I, NITRO⚡️, have been an integral part of the technology sector. I’ve always been fascinated by innovations and started working early, achieving victories, facing challenges, and overcoming setbacks. Every step was a lesson, every difficulty an opportunity for growth. That's how I see life 😉!
👉And this is what has shaped me into who I am today: someone who persists, who seeks, and who achieves their goals, never bowing their head!

🤯 The Cryptocurrency Challenge - A Journey of Skepticism and Courage 

In 2017, I was introduced to the world of cryptocurrencies. With my "down-to-earth" profile, I looked at this uncertain universe with skepticism 🤨. But, against my conservative nature, I decided to take a risk at the peak of BTC at 19K. How crazy 🫣!

What seemed like a mistake soon turned into valuable learning. I kept following the market with more attention 🔍, until I realized that the crypto economy was a world with no turning back.

Since then, my journey has been one of relentless pursuit of knowledge. Knowledge about the real values of projects, their innovations, and structures. I knew that if I wanted to achieve great results, I would have to invest in deepening my understanding of this world 💻🪙.

The Encounter with RedStone 🫡

At the end of 2023, I was first introduced to RedStone through a Brazilian crypto community called Clube HOPE, formed by several visionary minds 🧠. At first, I looked at RedStone and observed... and then observed some more. 😮 What did I see? Something I had never found in any other project. A vibrant community, full of positive energy. A capable team, ALWAYS ONE STEP AHEAD 🏃‍♂️💨, bringing new partnerships and big names every day.

What surprised me the most? Innovation 🌐. RedStone is like that magic trick that transforms a simple matchbox into a shoebox before your eyes, and then transforms into several matchboxes again 🪄... That's the power of modularity and makes everything seem possible with the snap of a finger. Simply extraordinary!

My decision was clear: I connected my "umbilical cord" to RedStone ♦️. I decided to absorb everything this innovative project had to offer, while committing to contribute my dedication to help them grow even more.

The Creation of RedStone Brazil and Portugal 🇧🇷🇵🇹 = A Double Challenge 

In March 2024, observing the incredible work of my friend @LeCriptal in creating his local community, I decided to go further: to create the local community for RedStone, RedStone Brazil and Portugal @redstone_ptbr. This was not just a challenge, it was two challenges in one 😅!

This moment marks one of the biggest milestones in my entire real-life and Web3 journey. For the first time, I dedicated myself with such passion and determination 🚀, sacrificing nights of sleep 😴, dividing my time between RedStone, my company 🧑‍💼 and my children 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦. Translating documents, developing strategies and conducting meetings with influencers while accompanying my brother with heart problems in the hospital night after night. My goal 🎯? To make RedStone known throughout South America, Portugal and all Portuguese-speaking countries.

Dedication Without Expectations = The Spirit of Community

One of the lessons that life has taught me is that, in times like these, financial return should never be the central motivation.. I never asked for anything from RedStone. I simply decided to make it happen. And with the support of the team, together, we managed to transform an idea into one of the largest local RedStone communities, now officially recognized.

I am deeply grateful to RedStone for making this real, and especially to the core team - @MarcinRedStone, @0xjvrsky, @grokier_  and the rest of the team.

Gratitude 🤝

I thank my miners who accepted my challenge and joined me, forming the official team of the RedStone PT BR community: @vinicius_cairo, @Mr_Sangria_, @JoelTedim. You are part of the reason we’ve come this far.

Thank you to the Deep Miner family ⛑️, there are few of us, but there will never be another like us. Thank you for the support and strength you have given me.

And, of course, to all the Vein Masters 🗺️ and miners ⛏️ who always cheer for my achievements. If, for some reason, the rest of my life goes wrong, I could always work making plush toys for kids 🧸 or scary pumpkins for Halloween 🎃.  With you guys, nothing seems impossible! 🤣🤣🤣

🔮 The Future

And now? What’s next?

Now comes much more! Get ready, because the first in-person miners’ meetup in Brazil 🇧🇷 is about to happen! We will make history together, continuing to build and advance the mission of making RedStone the #1 oracle 🚀.

The future is bright, and there are no limits to what we can achieve together.
By builders, for builders 🏗️

🚨Launching All Risk Is Creative, a podcast about risk and the creative act of risk-taking.

I am committed to doing this for the next 8-10 years.

Each episode is a reminder to myself and the listener that everything in this world was built because someone decided to take a risk.

Episodes are short (~45 mins) - they aren’t deep-dives but broad strokes of storytelling, ideas and megatrends.

The first episode is PV Narasimha Rao, without whose risk, my life and yours would be very different today.

Next few episodes are on Socrates, Howard Shultz, Lee Kuan Yew, Steven Spielberg, and the Tatas.

It will mean a lot if you listen to the first episode (link below, and in bio). I want to get really good at this so please tell me what you think.

tweets.text:
Peter Thiel on the importance of a powerful story

When asked what he looks for in an entrepreneur to back, Thiel responds:

“We’re looking for companies where there is a very powerful narrative around the company. Obviously you want people who are very smart, very talented… But beyond that, there has to be an ability to attract a number of other talented people. And that’s how you really build the critical mass that builds these great businesses.”

He continues:

“Normally when we find talented people with a powerful story, that’s almost enough for us to invest. I think that’s actually very rare at this point. But you have to ask the question, what will motivate the 20th or 30th or 40th employee to join this company? It’s probably not financial and it’s probably not fame or anything like that. It has to be that they believe that there’s something incredibly powerful and valuable about what it’s doing.”

Video source: @cwclub (2011)
